name: video-workflow
description: Turn one sentence or a locked script into sourced, synchronized, multi-format video with a free local production path.

interface.shortDescription: One sentence to sourced, verified video
interface.longDescription: Tell Codex what video to make in one sentence. The plugin structures explainers, lists, workflows, comparisons, promos, or real data stories; creates free local narration, content-driven diagrams, synchronized captions and animation; then validates facts, audio, visual safety, and multi-format renders without paid media APIs, HyperFrames, or Remotion.
capabilities: Real sourced charts and dimensional comparisons
Platform-safe landscape, portrait, and social outputs
Multilingual captions, voices, and pronunciation dictionaries
Optional music, sound effects, and automatic ducking
SRT, VTT, storyboard, cover, and fact-check deliverables
Versioned script revision and scene-level render cache
Visual, factual, audio, and timing quality gates
defaultPrompt: Make a vertical explainer video about MCP.
Make a six-item list video about useful Codex Skills.
Make a sourced data story from this CSV and export all three formats.
Check this video project for caption, audio, and timing drift.
